title: ASEAN, Regional Architecture, and India's Act East

scenes.text: Why did India shift its foreign policy gaze eastward?
scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered why India shifted its focus eastward after the Cold War? With the collapse of the Soviet Union, India looked east to find dynamic new trade partners.

scenes.text: Reaching out beyond your doorstep to make vibrant, supportive neighbourhood friends.
scenes.narration: Think of this as an analogy: when your own neighbourhood shop closes, you walk across to the vibrant market next door to trade and build friendly ties.

scenes.heading: India's ASEAN Partnership Journey

events.what: Sectoral dialogue partner under Look East

scenes.narration: Look at how India steadily stepped up its ASEAN relationship over time. Starting with Prime Minister Narasimha Rao in 1992, India advanced step by step from sectoral partner to a full strategic partnership.

scenes.heading: Look East versus Act East
scenes.narration: Here is the trick to tell them apart. Look East focused mainly on economic diplomacy in South East Asia, whereas Act East reaches across the wider Asia-Pacific with strong strategic and maritime security cooperation.

scenes.name: C. Raja Mohan
scenes.idea: Act East brings unprecedented speed, scale, and space to Indian diplomacy.
scenes.narration: Is Act East just clever rebranding? Renowned scholar C. Raja Mohan explains that it is far more, highlighting unprecedented speed, greater scale, and wider geographic space in India's engagement.

scenes.heading: Connectivity and Regional Architecture
items: Focus on tourism, culture, education, and transport
APEC practices open regionalism through voluntary pledges
scenes.narration: Imagine physical roads linking civilisations together. Through the Mekong Ganga Cooperation, India builds cultural and transport corridors like the Trilateral Highway, while groups like APEC pursue open regionalism through voluntary commitments.

items: ASEAN forms the nucleus of Asia-Pacific architecture.
Act East deepens strategic, economic, and maritime ties.
Mekong Ganga Cooperation advances civilisational connectivity.
scenes.narration: Keep these three takeaways in mind: ASEAN anchors the regional architecture, Act East expands India's strategic reach, and connectivity platforms build enduring partnerships.
